title: 虚拟内存：地址切分、多级页表与 TLB 翻译全过程
expected_output:
=== address decomposition ===
  virtual address = 32 bits
  page size       = 4096 B  -> offset = 12 bits
  VPN             = 20 bits -> 1048576 virtual pages

  single-level page table = 1048576 entries x 4 B = 4194304 B = 4 MB PER PROCESS
  ...which is exactly why we go multi-level: most of that table is empty

  two-level: VPN -> [10-bit L1 index][10-bit L2 index]
  L1 table: 1024 entries x 4 B = 4096 B (fits exactly in one 4 KB page)
  L2 tables: allocated ON DEMAND, at most 1024 of them, in practice only a few

  best case for single-level (all pages used) : 4194304 B
  realistic two-level (256 L2 tables used)    : 1052672 B

=== translation trace (TLB has 4 entries) ===
    vpn outcome        detail
      0 TLB MISS       L1[0] -> L2[0] -> ppn 100 (2 memory reads) -> refill TLB
      1 TLB MISS       L1[0] -> L2[1] -> ppn 101 (2 memory reads) -> refill TLB
      0 TLB HIT        -> ppn 100, no page-table walk
      2 TLB MISS       L1[0] -> L2[2] -> ppn 102 (2 memory reads) -> refill TLB
      8 INVALID        L1[0] -> L2[8] -> valid bit 0 and not on disk -> segmentation fault
      7 PAGE FAULT     L1[0] -> L2[7] -> valid bit 0 -> load from disk (ppn 907) -> RESTART the instruction
      8 INVALID        L1[0] -> L2[8] -> valid bit 0 and not on disk -> segmentation fault
      0 TLB HIT        -> ppn 100, no page-table walk
      5 INVALID        L1[0] -> L2[5] -> valid bit 0 and not on disk -> segmentation fault

=== reading the trace ===
  vpn 0 first: TLB miss, walk the two-level table, refill TLB
  vpn 0 again: TLB hit -> no memory traffic for translation at all
  vpn 7     : valid bit 0 but present on disk -> PAGE FAULT, ~10^6 cycles
              after the page is brought in, the instruction is RE-EXECUTED
  vpn 5     : valid bit 0 and not on disk -> that is a segmentation fault, not a page fault

  TLB reach = 4 entries x 4096 B = 16384 B
  if the working set exceeds the reach, the TLB thrashes no matter how big the cache is
code:
VA_BITS   = 32
PAGE_BITS = 12                       # 页大小 4 KB
PTE_BYTES = 4
VPN_BITS  = VA_BITS - PAGE_BITS      # 20 位虚拟页号

print("=== address decomposition ===")
print("  virtual address = %d bits" % VA_BITS)
print("  page size       = %d B  -> offset = %d bits" % (1 << PAGE_BITS, PAGE_BITS))
print("  VPN             = %d bits -> %d virtual pages" % (VPN_BITS, 1 << VPN_BITS))
print()
single = (1 << VPN_BITS) * PTE_BYTES
print("  single-level page table = %d entries x %d B = %d B = %d MB PER PROCESS"
      % (1 << VPN_BITS, PTE_BYTES, single, single >> 20))
print("  ...which is exactly why we go multi-level: most of that table is empty")

# 两级页表：页号各 10 位
L1_BITS = L2_BITS = 10
assert L1_BITS + L2_BITS == VPN_BITS
print()
print("  two-level: VPN -> [%d-bit L1 index][%d-bit L2 index]" % (L1_BITS, L2_BITS))
print("  L1 table: %d entries x %d B = %d B (fits exactly in one 4 KB page)"
      % (1 << L1_BITS, PTE_BYTES, (1 << L1_BITS) * PTE_BYTES))
print("  L2 tables: allocated ON DEMAND, at most %d of them, in practice only a few"
      % (1 << L1_BITS))
print()
print("  best case for single-level (all pages used) : %d B" % single)
print("  realistic two-level (256 L2 tables used)    : %d B"
      % ((1 << L1_BITS) * PTE_BYTES + 256 * (1 << L2_BITS) * PTE_BYTES))

# ---------------- 地址翻译模拟 ----------------
TLB_ENTRIES = 4
tlb = {}                      # vpn -> ppn
page_table = {}               # vpn -> (valid, ppn)
disk_pages = set()            # 在磁盘上、可以被换入的页

def touch(vpn):
    """一次地址翻译；返回 (结果, 说明)"""
    if vpn in tlb:
        return "TLB HIT", "-> ppn %d, no page-table walk" % tlb[vpn]
    # TLB 缺失 -> 走两级页表
    l1 = (vpn >> L2_BITS) & ((1 << L1_BITS) - 1)
    l2 = vpn & ((1 << L2_BITS) - 1)
    walks = "L1[%d] -> L2[%d]" % (l1, l2)
    ent = page_table.get(vpn)
    if ent is None or ent[0] == 0:
        if vpn in disk_pages:
            ppn = 900 + vpn
            page_table[vpn] = (1, ppn)
            if len(tlb) >= TLB_ENTRIES:
                tlb.pop(next(iter(tlb)))
            tlb[vpn] = ppn
            return "PAGE FAULT", "%s -> valid bit 0 -> load from disk (ppn %d) -> RESTART the instruction" % (walks, ppn)
        return "INVALID", "%s -> valid bit 0 and not on disk -> segmentation fault" % walks
    ppn = ent[1]
    if len(tlb) >= TLB_ENTRIES:
        tlb.pop(next(iter(tlb)))       # 简化的 FIFO 淘汰
    tlb[vpn] = ppn
    return "TLB MISS", "%s -> ppn %d (2 memory reads) -> refill TLB" % (walks, ppn)

# 预置：页 0..3 常驻，页 7 在磁盘上
for p in range(4):
    page_table[p] = (1, 100 + p)
disk_pages.add(7)

print()
print("=== translation trace (TLB has %d entries) ===" % TLB_ENTRIES)
print("  %5s %-14s %s" % ("vpn", "outcome", "detail"))
for vpn in (0, 1, 0, 2, 8, 7, 8, 0, 5):
    kind, detail = touch(vpn)
    print("  %5d %-14s %s" % (vpn, kind, detail))

print()
print("=== reading the trace ===")
print("  vpn 0 first: TLB miss, walk the two-level table, refill TLB")
print("  vpn 0 again: TLB hit -> no memory traffic for translation at all")
print("  vpn 7     : valid bit 0 but present on disk -> PAGE FAULT, ~10^6 cycles")
print("              after the page is brought in, the instruction is RE-EXECUTED")
print("  vpn 5     : valid bit 0 and not on disk -> that is a segmentation fault, not a page fault")
print()
print("  TLB reach = %d entries x %d B = %d B" % (TLB_ENTRIES, 1 << PAGE_BITS, TLB_ENTRIES << PAGE_BITS))
print("  if the working set exceeds the reach, the TLB thrashes no matter how big the cache is")
